# Sample capstone deck

**SAMPLE. Not approved for presentation.** Generated by the Presentation Studio ([PRESENTATION-STUDIO](../../../architecture-studio/PRESENTATION-STUDIO.md)) from commit `7faeb8c` of this repository. It is an editable PowerPoint (native text, charts and tables; no pictures) with speaker notes on every slide.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `deck-7faeb8c-20261030T171910/deck.pptx` | The editable deck, 40 slides |
| `deck-7faeb8c-20261030T171910/render/deck.pdf` | The same deck as rendered by Microsoft PowerPoint |
| `deck-7faeb8c-20261030T171910/render/slide-*.png` | Six representative previews. The build produced 40; the rest are not kept here |
| `deck-7faeb8c-20261030T171910/render/layout.json` | What PowerPoint measured for every shape (the overflow checks read this) |
| `deck-7faeb8c-20261030T171910/generation.json` | The audit record: commit, every source with its hash, every slide's content hash and review state, the gate, the quality result, the output hashes |
| `deck-7faeb8c-20261030T171910/qa.json` | The quality findings (0 errors, 0 warnings, 8 notes) |

Verify it: `node apps/architecture-studio/scripts/deck.ts verify docs/capstone/presentation/pptx/deck-7faeb8c-20261030T171910`

## What the gate says about it

A final deck needs an authorized architecture baseline, every presented decision approved, and every slide approved by a person. **None of those is true**, so this is a sample, and each slide says so. Seven slides carry a review placeholder where the repository holds no evidence (volumes and premiums, measured time saved, performance, recovery, telemetry, rehearsal). No photograph and no official Azure icon is used.
